positions.title: Project and Production Manager
positions.description:
Integral is a global provider of coaching and leadership solutions for international companies and organisations requiring flexible, innovative and productive leaders.

Integral helps organisations to attract, develop and retain key leaders by providing challenging learning & development opportunities through coaching and facilitation that deliver on-going, measurable results.

Integral offers a global service via a network of certified and highly experienced coaches and facilitators. Integral supplies the perfect mix of language, culture and industry knowledge to provide significant added value to your leadership programme or coaching initiative.

positions.title: Knowledge Worker and Process Facilitator
positions.description:
Member of a network of practitioners in the design and delivery of collaborative workshops using the MG Taylor methods and models for transformational change, which are based on fundamental principles of individual and group creativity, focused problem definition and rapid iterations of solutions.
• Responsible for designing, building, and using environments, processes, and tools that systematically and repeatedly release
the clients ability to solve complex issues during workshops.
• Facilitation and knowledge-working practice includes working with large and small companies (Allianz, AMB Generali,
Dresdner Bank, Holcim, Merck, Nokia, PA Consulting, Solvay, etc.) government agencies (ESA, BMBF), and non-profits
(World Economic Program, World Food Program, European Brain Council).
• Particular challenges include organizational transformation, mergers, supply chain management, information management
systems, work process re-engineering, developing marketing organization and channels, IT development and projects, and activities related to setting the global agenda.

positions.title: PR and Program Manager, Liason with FIFA and UEFA
positions.company: OTI Organización de Telecomunicaciones Iberoamericanas, A.C.
positions.description:
The company is responsible for marketing the FIFA and UEFA Media Rights within the Latin American territory and supporting all Sub-Licensees within the territory during FIFA events such as the FIFA World Cup.
Activities relating to Media Rights Marketing:
•	Responsible for making and finalizing the contracts with all Sub-Licensees.
•	Monitor all billing and payment processes.
•	Appointed main contact for all communication with FIFA and UEFA and our Sub-Licensees.
•	Supervise that all Media Right Holders fulfill their obligations.
•	Redefine and implement business processes within the company.
Activities during FIFA events include (e.g. 2014 FIFA World Cup Brazil):
•	Manage VIP and “high profile” clients and guests.
•	Coordinate event logistics, accommodation, transportation and ticket management worth over 2  Million USD.
